text_block_list.name: Daring Heart
text_block_list.text:
Hey, Scarlet.
Mind if I listen to music while running?

text_block_list.name: Daiwa Scarlet
text_block_list.text: Huh? Yes, I don't mind at all.

text_block_list.name: Daring Heart
text_block_list.text:
Phew... good run.
Worked up a nice sweat.

text_block_list.name: Daiwa Scarlet
text_block_list.text:
That run just now...
Your form has way less wasted movement than before!

text_block_list.name: Daiwa Scarlet
text_block_list.text: What is that music even supposed to be?

text_block_list.name: Daring Heart
text_block_list.text:
It's a special playlist for roadwork♪
My Trainer put all the tracks together for me!

text_block_list.name: Daring Heart
text_block_list.text: You know how I used to tense up way too much when I ran, right?

text_block_list.name: Daring Heart
text_block_list.text:
She saw right through it
and took countermeasures for me.

text_block_list.name: Daring Heart
text_block_list.text: Right! Listening to this music relaxes me and helps me run smoothly!

text_block_list.name: Daiwa Scarlet
text_block_list.text:
“—I see.
You've gotten pretty decent at it, haven't you?”

text_block_list.name: Daiwa Scarlet
text_block_list.text:
Still! I'm the one who's going to take first place!
That's never going to change!

text_block_list.name: Daring Heart
text_block_list.text:
"Wouldn't have it
any other way!
I have no intention of giving up the future summit either!"
